title: The 5th Wave
author: Rick Yancey
summary: After four waves of alien attacks have wiped out most of humanity, sixteen-year-old Cassie sets out alone to rescue her little brother while trusting no one, since the invaders can look human.
readIf: you like fast, bleak teen survival stories with an alien invasion twist.
skipIf: you dislike shifting narrators or want hopeful, low-stakes science fiction.
